text: I have often seen people of superior, governed by people of much inferior parts, without knowing or even suspecting that they were so governed. This can only happen when those people of inferior parts have more worldly dexterity and experience, than those they govern.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CLXV, to his son, London, April 30, Old Style 1752
